Collection disabled pending repository access, publication terms and bounded spend verification. Label boat (Boat's default size: 4 vCPU, 8 GB, 51 GB disk, $0.036 per hour). The CI page also says a job gets 4 GB from Boat plus swap, so the memory limit is unclear. Boat's own CI runner (docs.boat.dev/ci and docs.boat.dev/pricing.md, read 2026-11-08): a fresh sandbox per job on shared vCPUs, no promised CPU model, billed per second, CI needs Boat's $20/month plan, extra starts above the plan's included ones cost $0.03 to $0.07. The docs do not name the Ubuntu release, so the image is what the job reports. Boat refuses jobs from public repositories until the account owner runs `boat ci public <account> on`. Boat's terms (boat.dev/terms, effective 2026-10-12) have no benchmark, comparison or confidentiality clause about Boat; TOS-10 forbids probing or evading usage limits and metering, which this suite does not do.
